name: va_tower_clock
notes: A civic clock tower 6 m square and 28 m tall: an arched 2.5 m passage runs through the ground floor from front to back, with the stair in a side room; a round clock face on each side under an open arched lantern with a bell, over a saffron and cobalt tile band. The passage opens on local -Z; stairs climb eight floors to a terrace with a 1.25 m parapet. White limewash with cobalt trim since v2.
